ann.t: General Updates — Caliber Mining and Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about receipt of resignation letter from the company secretary and compliance officer

Alteration/revision(s) — Caliber Mining and Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about Alteration/revision(s) in the mechanism for payment on account of diesel price variation under Mining Service Contracts with subsidiaries of Coal India Limited

General Updates — CMLL: As required by exchange, Caliber Mining and Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange about resubmission of financial results for the period ended 30-Jun-2026 in Machine Readable Form / Legible copy

Press Release — Caliber Mining and Logistics Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated August 11, 2026, titled "Press Release on the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) for the quarter ended June 30, 2026.".
Outcome of Board Meeting — Caliber Mining and Logistics Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.
